title: NASA-UAP-VM002, Apollo 12, 1969
what_is_it: A NASA archival photograph of the lunar surface taken during the Apollo 12 mission, annotated by the government to highlight two areas of interest.
interpretation_warnings: Metadata-only extraction: no readable text was recovered from the file, so all facts derive from the war.gov CSV description rather than the image or an accompanying report.
The 'unidentified phenomena' are described only in a brief government caption; no analysis, measurement, or explanation of what they are is provided.
The image has been altered (highlighted) by the releasing agency, which explicitly states this is for contextual location only and is not a conclusion about the subject matter.
Single-source: no observer statements, sensor data, or corroborating documents accompany the photograph.

verifiable_claims.claim: The photograph depicts the lunar surface as viewed from the Apollo 12 landing site.
